description: This file defines the LocaleTools class, which provides utility methods for handling locale settings within an Android application, including applying a locale to a context and parsing locale strings.

classes.name: LocaleTools
classes.description: Utility class for locale-related operations such as applying locale to context and parsing locale strings.

methods.name: applyLocaleToContext
methods.description: Applies the specified locale string to the given Android context by updating its configuration.

methods.name: getLocaleForLocaleString
methods.description: Parses a locale string and returns the corresponding Locale object, defaulting to system locale on failure or if input is 'System' or empty.
